config.general.title: General
config.enabled.name: Enable Effect
config.enabled.tooltip:
Turns the blur effect on or off.
All other settings are ignored while disabled.
config.blur.title: Blur Settings
config.blurType.name: Blur Type
config.blurType.tooltip:
Algorithm used to render the blur:

 Gaussian - smooth, even frosted-glass look. Good default.
 Bokeh- shaped aperture blur; bright highlights become geometric bokeh spots.
 Motion  - directional streaking, like a fast-moving camera.
config.bokehShape.name: Bokeh Shape
config.bokehShape.tooltip:
Aperture shape used for the Bokeh blur.
Determines the silhouette that bright highlights take when out of focus.

 Circle  - round disk (most natural)
 Hexagon - 6-blade aperture (classic camera look)
 Star - 5-pointed star
 Heart- heart-shaped highlights
 Diamond - rotated square

Only applies when Blur Type is set to Bokeh.
config.bokehRadius.name: Bokeh Size
config.bokehRadius.tooltip:
Radius of the bokeh aperture disk (shown as screen pixels at current Blur Strength).
Small values produce a subtle, barely-visible shape.
Large values make the shape clearly recognisable but also increase the blur spread.

Only applies when Blur Type is set to Bokeh.
config.strength.name: Blur Strength
config.strength.tooltip:
How much the frame is downscaled before blurring.
Higher - stronger, wider blur.

2x - subtle haze
4x - noticeable frost
8x - strong blur
16x - heavy fog
config.passes.name: Blur Passes
config.passes.tooltip:
Number of blur iterations on the downscaled texture.
More passes - softer result. Runs at reduced resolution, so extra passes are cheap.
config.motionAngle.name: Motion Direction
config.motionAngle.tooltip:
Direction of the motion blur streak, in degrees.
0 - right | 90 - down | 180 - left | 270 - up

Only applies when Blur Type is set to Motion.
config.perf.title: Performance
config.interval.name: Update Interval
config.interval.tooltip:
How often (in frames) the blur texture is refreshed.
1 - updates every frame, smoothest but most costly.
2 - barely noticeable at 60 fps, roughly half the GPU cost.
Higher values - lower GPU load, but the background blur will visibly stutter.

Note: the first ~1.5 seconds after a menu opens always update
every frame to avoid a flash of stale content.
config.visual.title: Appearance
config.dim.name: Dim Strength
config.dim.tooltip:
Opacity of the dark overlay drawn on top of the blur.
Helps menu text stand out against a busy background.
0% - no darkening | 100% - fully black.
config.brightness.name: Blur Brightness
config.brightness.tooltip:
Brightness of the blurred layer.
Turn down if the background looks too bright behind the menu.
20% - very dark | 100% - full brightness.
config.exclusions.title: Exclusions
config.blurInDialogue.name: Blur during dialogue
config.blurInDialogue.tooltip:
Show the blur effect while an NPC is talking.
Off by default - plain dialogue is easier to read without it.
Turn on if you want a consistent look across all menus.
config.blurInFishing.name: Blur during fishing
config.blurInFishing.tooltip:
Show the blur effect during the fishing minigame.
On by default - the fishing bar will show up clearly on top of the blur.
